title: Helix Chamber 深度特写：解读田尻智自传漫画——初代胶囊怪兽草案、1992年内部人气投票与失落原案全考证
dek: 田尻智自传漫画披露1992年GAME FREAK内部人气投票与初代胶囊怪兽草案。
summary: 2018年5月17日，GAME FREAK设计师詹姆斯·特纳在推特发布田尻智自传漫画节选，其中一格展示了开发期间内部人气投票。Helix Chamber团队获取漫画并扫描，还原出1992至1993年间GAME FREAK内部人气投票的图表与结果，包括椰蛋树、吉利蛋、皮皮等排名，以及初代胶囊怪兽草案中的未采用设计，如嘎奥斯、仙人掌、Jagg等。文章还分析了宝可梦内部ID顺序、叫声数据索引，并提及1992年10月第一次投票中椰蛋树获第一、呆壳兽第二、皮皮第三。

segments.alt: Historical illustration

segments.original: On May 17th, 2018, Game Freak designer James Turner (the creator of Pokémon like Vanillite, Golurk, and Poipole) tweeted pictures of a few excerpts from the then-recently published manga about Satoshi Tajiri’s life and the creation of Game Freak. Interestingly enough, despite claims from the developers that most of the documentation about the first two Pokémon games either never existed or was lost to time, one of the panels in this manga contains a look at an internal poll during development. Our curiosity piqued, the Helix Chamber team – made up of translators, coders, people who know random trivia about the franchise, nerds, magnification wizards, you name it – gathered together, obtained a copy of the manga, scanned everything, and were able to unearth quite a lot of information.
segments.translation: 2018年5月17日，GAME FREAK的设计师詹姆斯·特纳（James Turner，他创作了迷你冰、泥偶巨人、毒贝比等宝可梦）在推特上发布了几张当时刚出版的、关于田尻智生平及GAME FREAK创立过程的漫画节选图片。有趣的是，尽管开发者声称关于最初两款宝可梦游戏的大部分文档要么从未存在过，要么已随时间遗失，但这部漫画的其中一格却展示了开发期间的一次内部投票。 这激起了我们的好奇心，Helix Chamber团队——由翻译、程序员、了解该系列冷知识的人、书呆子、放大图像的高手等等组成——集结起来，获取了一本漫画，扫描了所有内容，并成功发掘出了相当多的信息。

segments.alt: Historical illustration

segments.original: At first glance, this is a chart with a few things that aren’t found in the first Pokémon games (B), and a bunch of mysterious, warped monsters peering out from a skewed grid in the bottom panel (A). Along with the Pokémon charts, there’s also a table with votes and a results sheet (B). All three of these documents were made for one of the several popularity polls (人気投票) that Game Freak held periodically in order to rate their Pokémon designs and help decide which monsters would be in the final game.
segments.translation: 乍看之下，这是一张图表，上面有一些初代宝可梦游戏中没有的东西（B），以及一堆神秘的、扭曲的怪兽从底部面板（A）中一个歪斜的网格里窥视。 除了宝可梦图表外，还有一张带有投票数的表格和一张结果单（B）。这三份文件都是为GAME FREAK定期举办的数次人气投票（人気投票）之一而制作的，目的是评估他们的宝可梦设计，并帮助决定哪些怪兽会出现在最终游戏中。

segments.original: The first poll was reportedly held in October of 1992, when the crew surprisingly voted Exeggutor in as their favorite. However, the second place shown in the manga ( 1 – Exeggutor, 2 – Chansey, 3 – Clefairy) doesn’t match with the first poll records, which reported Slowbro in second place. These were mentioned in the book by Akihito Tomisawa about the history of Game Freak: “ゲームフリーク ―遊びの世界標準を塗り替えるクリエイティブ集団”, published by Media Factory, page 106-7. This poll was also mentioned by Morimoto’s ingame character in Pokémon Sun and Moon. (The first poll account is pretty interesting, and we’ll report it below…). This leads us to hypothesize that the Tajiri manga poll was not the first one held; instead, the poll was held either in the last months of 1992 or in 1993.
segments.translation: 据报道，第一次投票于1992年10月举行，当时团队成员出人意料地将椰蛋树选为他们最喜欢的宝可梦。然而，漫画中显示的第二名（1 – 椰蛋树，2 – 吉利蛋，3 – 皮皮）与第一次投票的记录不符，记录显示第二名是呆壳兽。这些在富泽昭仁关于GAME FREAK历史的书中提到过： “ゲームフリーク ―遊びの世界標準を塗り替えるクリエイティブ集団”，Media Factory出版，第106-7页。森本在《宝可梦 太阳／月亮》中的游戏角色也提到了这次投票。（第一次投票的记述相当有趣，我们将在下面报告……）。 这让我们推测，田尻智漫画中的投票并非第一次；相反，这次投票要么是在1992年的最后几个月，要么是在1993年举行的。

segments.original: THE POPULARITY POLLS
segments.translation: 人气投票

segments.original: On the left side of panel B, we can see a page titled “Popularity Poll Results Announcement” (人気投票結果発表);  this piece of paper covering up the grid is the internal poll results, listing the winners and the number of votes that each one got. We’ve also been able to guess the top 31 by cross-referencing the material, albeit restoring the exact 11-20 order is not possible, unfortunately.
segments.translation: 在面板B的左侧，我们可以看到一页标题为“人气投票结果発表”（人気投票結果発表）的纸张；这张覆盖在网格上的纸是内部投票结果，列出了获胜者以及每人获得的票数。我们还通过交叉比对材料，推测出了前31名，尽管不幸的是，无法还原确切的第11至20名的顺序。

segments.original: Now, some people might recognize the numbers on the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th sheet matching the Internal ID order, which is the order in which Pokémon are organized within Red and Green’s programming. Unlike Generation II onwards, the Pokémon are not listed in Pokédex order. The first sheet follows the cry data order instead – more on that later. Some Pokémon are marked with triangles and circles, which are commonly used in Japan for ranking, with best-to-worst being: ◎ ◯ △ × , where the double circle is perfect, and the triangle means that it needs improvement. As a side note, in the final RG games, there are several sprites which don’t look like they were made directly by any individual credited artist. Instead, they look rather hastily scaled down. There is some evidence supporting that they did this within the poll; someone thought to re-proportion Pokémon who had received an evolution later in development. These sprites in the final games were already pretty blatantly rescaled, even before the evidence was solid enough. Some others were at least re-polished or re-drawn from scratch, like Venonat and Krabby. We also have evidence that a couple of bigger sprites were reworked into their respective evolutions (Doduo, Krabby).
segments.translation: 现在，有些人可能会认出第2、3、4张表上的数字与内部ID顺序相符，这是宝可梦在红绿编程中的组织顺序。与第二世代及以后不同，宝可梦并非按宝可梦图鉴顺序列出。第一张表则遵循叫声数据顺序——稍后会详细说明。 一些宝可梦标有三角形和圆形，这在日本常用于排名，从最好到最差依次为：◎ ◯ △ ×，其中双圆圈代表完美，三角形表示需要改进。 顺便提一下，在最终的红绿游戏中，有几个点阵图看起来不像是任何署名艺术家直接制作的。相反，它们看起来像是仓促缩小的。有一些证据支持他们在投票中这样做了；有人认为要重新调整那些在开发后期获得进化的宝可梦的比例。最终游戏中的这些点阵图已经明显被重新调整过比例，甚至在证据足够确凿之前就已如此。其他一些至少被重新润色或从头重绘，比如毛球和大钳蟹。我们还有证据表明，一些较大的点阵图被改造成了它们各自的进化形态（嘟嘟、大钳蟹）。

segments.original: POKÉMON ANALYSIS
segments.translation: 宝可梦分析

segments.original: Bios for everything here! Deleted or massively changed Pokémon are highlighted in blue. Once again, the Internal index order so you can follow along and the unused cries so you can listen along.
segments.translation: 这里包含了所有宝可梦的简介！被删除或大幅更改的宝可梦以蓝色高亮显示。再次按照内部索引顺序排列，以便您对照查看，并附上未使用的叫声，以便您同步聆听。

segments.original: Block 1 doesn’t follow or even use index numbers. Instead, Pokémon are marked with a circled number that differs from the order in which they were programmed. These numbers instead match up with a different data list in the game, that being the cry data index. Each cry base (or melody) has a different hex value in the code. For example, Nidoran’s is 0x00 (decimal 0), Spearow’s is 0x10 (decimal 16), and Rhydon’s is 0x11 (decimal 17). Note that the decimal values are exactly one less than the numbers with which these Pokémon were marked on the sheet. Blastoise, Pinsir and Tangela are way off, since they are marked with 35-37 instead of the expected 19-21.
segments.translation: 区块1不遵循甚至不使用索引编号。相反，宝可梦被标记了一个带圈的数字，该数字与它们被编程的顺序不同。这些数字反而与游戏中的另一个数据列表相匹配，即叫声数据索引。每个叫声基础（或旋律）在代码中都有不同的十六进制值。例如，尼多兰的是0x00（十进制0），烈雀的是0x10（十进制16），钻角犀兽的是0x11（十进制17）。 请注意，十进制值正好比这些宝可梦在表上标记的数字小一。水箭龟、凯罗斯和蔓藤怪则相差甚远，因为它们被标记为35-37，而不是预期的19-21。

segments.original: The meaning of this is yet to be determined, but we suspect that it has to do either with their cries originally having a different hex value or some sort of Pokémon index number reordering later on. More insights about that in our new Game Informer documents analysis.
segments.translation: 其含义尚未确定，但我们怀疑要么与它们的叫声最初具有不同的十六进制值有关，要么与后来某种宝可梦索引编号的重新排序有关。更多见解请参见我们对新的Game Informer文件的分析。

segments.original: Gyaoon is interesting. Its name is the onomatopoeia for Godzilla’s roar, and it has elements that later would be incorporated into strong, kaiju-like Pokémon such as Tyranitar, Charizard, and even Feraligatr. Although sporting a fairly different design, it can be identified with No.1 on the Capumon sprite sheet mainly because of its open mouth and pose. It might even share some pixels in the head/mouth region with its former sprite. In the poll, they scratched out the ース” (a)su ” in its name, which means its name was Gyaasu or “Gyarth” at some point. It was likely cut for not being very distinct, although it lives on through the Pokémon that inherited its design elements. Its number is too blurry to identify or even guess, and it’s not featured in the final cry list. The new Game Informer document might have revealed its original placement to be 16, thus revealing its cry. Check out our Lost Pokémon page for more.
segments.translation: 嘎奥斯很有趣。它的名字是哥斯拉吼声的拟声词，并且它包含了后来被融入强大怪兽型宝可梦（如班基拉斯、喷火龙，甚至大力鳄）的元素。尽管设计相当不同，但主要因为张开的嘴和姿势，它可以与胶囊怪兽点阵图表上的No.1相对应。它甚至可能在头部/嘴部区域与前一个点阵图共享一些像素。在投票中，他们划掉了名字中的“ース”（a）su”，这意味着它的名字在某个时候是Gyaasu或“Gyarth”。它很可能因为不够独特而被删除，尽管它通过继承了其设计元素的宝可梦而存续下来。它的编号太模糊，无法识别甚至猜测，并且没有出现在最终的叫声列表中。新的Game Informer文件可能揭示了它原本的位置是16，从而揭示了它的叫声。查看我们的失落宝可梦页面了解更多。

Check out our Lost Pokémon page for more.

segments.alt: No. 18 ガガース GAGARS - RHYDON NOT RANKED.

segments.translation: 这个没有钻角犀兽的钻角点阵图出现在1990年的胶囊怪兽图像中。除了角，它看起来与最终点阵图相似。然而，印刷品确实表明，最终版的阴影略有改变。

segments.original: Its sprite is very similar to the final, but still shows some remnants of the original Capumon sprite‘s shading on the tail. Despite its usual nightmarish appearance, it placed 22 in the poll.
segments.translation: 它的点阵图与最终版非常相似，但尾巴上仍显示出原始胶囊怪兽点阵图阴影的一些痕迹。尽管它通常有着噩梦般的外表，但在投票中排名第22。

segments.original: Block 2
segments.translation: 区块2

segments.original: This block had to be heavily reconstructed, as it is about 2cm tall and tilted in the manga. Some sprites were deliberately brightened by the manga editors, leaving just a faded trail of dots. We were able to line up some of the final sprites with the dots, but not all of them had perfect matches. The editors also removed the various ranking marks, although we were able to restore some of the circled Pokémon, we won’t mark any as “Not ranked” since definitive evidence is missing. These Pokémon are mostly in order, with some slots flipped by one place.
segments.translation: 这一部分不得不进行大量重建，因为它在漫画中只有约2厘米高且倾斜。部分精灵图被漫画编辑刻意调亮，只留下模糊的点阵痕迹。我们能够将一些最终精灵图与点阵对齐，但并非所有都能完美匹配。编辑还移除了各种排名标记，尽管我们能够还原一些被圈出的宝可梦，但由于缺乏确凿证据，我们不会将任何宝可梦标记为“未上榜”。这些宝可梦大致按顺序排列，有些位置可能前后颠倒了一位。

segments.original: This may be Mr. Mime, but the sprite doesn’t match the dots completely. There’s a “Baririina” on the poll which would imply a ballerina… so maybe Mr. Mime (バリヤード/Barrierd) had a different career choice at this point in development. That name is also the exact same as its baby evolution in the Gold and Silver prototypes. Its looks may have been slightly different; there’s something quite different going on in the upper body area (shoulders, horns, hands), but it would be difficult, if not impossible, to define its appearance any further. Ranked 11-20 in the poll. Check out our Lost Pokémon page for more.
segments.translation: 这可能是魔墙人偶，但精灵图与点阵不完全匹配。投票中有一个“Baririina”，暗示芭蕾舞演员……所以也许魔墙人偶（バリヤード/Barrierd）在开发阶段的这个时间点有不同的职业选择。这个名字也与金银原型中的宝宝进化完全相同。它的外观可能略有不同；上半身区域（肩膀、角、手）有相当不同的设计，但进一步定义其外观即使并非不可能，也非常困难。在投票中排名第11-20位。更多信息请查看我们的失落宝可梦页面。

segments.original: Block 3

segments.original: Block 3 is the most bountiful of the four we have. Several early designs, names, and cut Pokémon are on this one, and it was the first to be posted online in May 2018. Of note here are several sprites that are marked with the triangle △ – none of those Pokémon are in the final game (since it meant “needs improvement”) except for Seel, whose design was overhauled significantly.
segments.translation: 区块 3 是我们所拥有的四个区块中最丰富的。其中包含若干早期设计、名称和被砍掉的宝可梦，它也是 2018 年 5 月最早被发布到网上的。值得注意的是，这里有几个点阵图被标记了三角形 △——除了白海狮（Seel）之外，这些宝可梦都没有出现在最终游戏中（因为 △ 意味着“需要改进”），而白海狮的设计则经历了重大修改。

segments.original: Deer was not long for this world, unfortunately. Elements may have gone into several Pokémon later though, some even surviving through decades of separation. Its final design and name might have changed if it had made it to the 190 cut. Seemingly, there’s already a fix proposed for one of its antlers on this sheet.
segments.translation: 不幸的是，这只鹿并未存活太久。 不过，它的元素可能后来融入了好几只宝可梦，有些甚至跨越数十年的分离而留存下来。如果它进入了那 190 只被砍掉的名单，其最终设计和名称或许会有所改变。看起来，这张表上已经有人提议要修正它的一只鹿角。

segments.original: No. 58 パウワウ PAUWAU - SEEL △ NEEDS IMPROVEMENT but CIRCLED.
segments.translation: No. 58 パウワウ PAUWAU - 小海狮 △ 需要改进，但被圈出。

segments.alt: No. 58 パウワウ PAUWAU - SEEL △ NEEDS IMPROVEMENT but CIRCLED.

segments.original: Oh boy, where to begin…? Seel went through quite the makeover in the final game. It appears to be more of a realistic seal, especially resembling a leopard seal, with several spots all over the top of its back. Then it reaches the head and just goes off the rails: very similar to Slakoth, with Chia Pet or Smoochum hair with some serious wall-eye going on. Possibly had a dark Shellder-like face with tusks and a big, human-like nose. We actually kinda like this version of Seel better, it looks more like something that would only know how to Headbutt other creatures at the start. Ranked between 11-20 in the chart but was marked as improvable. Check out our Lost Pokémon page for more.
segments.translation: 天哪，从何说起……？小海狮在最终游戏中经历了相当大的改头换面。它看起来更像一只写实的海豹，尤其像豹海豹，背部上方布满斑点。然后到了头部就彻底失控了：非常像懒人獭，顶着类似奇亚宠物或迷唇娃的毛发，还带着严重的斜视。可能有一张类似大舌贝的深色脸庞，长着獠牙和一个大而像人的鼻子。我们其实更喜欢这个版本的小海狮，它看起来更像那种一开始只会用头撞其他生物的家伙。在图表中排名第 11-20 位，但被标记为可改进。更多信息请查看我们的“失落宝可梦”页面。

segments.alt: No. 59 ディグダ DIGUDA - DIGLETT ◎ PERFECT and CIRCLED.

segments.original: The last place winner of the top 31 and has a circle mark next to it. I guess somebody really liked it. Morimoto, you’re not fooling anybody.
segments.translation: 在排名前 31 中位列最后一名，旁边还有一个圆圈标记。我猜有人真的很喜欢它。森本，你骗不了任何人。

segments.translation: No. 60 ??? - 在最终游戏中，第 60 号位置是肯泰罗，考虑到这份名单与索引顺序的吻合程度，我们没有理由认为这里不是肯泰罗。另外值得注意的是：猴怪、地鼠和肯泰罗均由森本茂树设计。对于同为森本创作的肯泰罗来说，位置靠近也说得通。

segments.original: What’s notable is that Pokémon named in the voting documents are also circled in the sprite chart. segments.original: taking both versions of the sprite sheet into consideration, we can see that the following Pokémon were circled: Magneton, Mankey, Seel, Diglett, Cactus, Tangela, Pinsir, Scyther, Voltorb, Grimer, Lickitung, Psyduck, Jynx, Articuno, Zapdos, the mysterious orb in question, and probably others which are obscured.

segments.original: We can safely assume that all of the aforementioned Pokémon were voted for, and their names are present in the voting table and the results sheet. Pokémon whose names appear on the voting documents, but are heavily obscured or nowhere to be seen on the sprite chart, are as follows: Exeggutor, Chansey, Clefairy, Kadabra, “Sleeper” (Drowzee), “Maiko” (Nidoking), “Buu” (Magmar), Poliwag, Hitmonlee, Slowbro, Cubone, “Fungus” (Parasect), Ditto, Baririna (probably connected to Mr. Mime), Exeggcute (its name is mostly obscured but it’s the only one that has “ma” as a final kana). There’s one mysterious name, Barunda(A), in the results sheet.
segments.translation: 我们可以安全地假设所有上述宝可梦都被投票了，它们的名字出现在投票表和结果表中。 名字出现在投票文件中，但在精灵图表上被严重遮挡或完全看不到的宝可梦如下：椰蛋树、吉利蛋、皮皮、勇吉拉、“Sleeper”（催眠貘）、“Maiko”（尼多王）、“Buu”（鸭嘴火兽）、蚊香蝌蚪、飞腿郎、呆壳兽、卡拉卡拉、“Fungus”（派拉斯特）、百变怪、Baririna（可能与魔墙人偶有关）、蛋蛋（它的名字大部分被遮挡，但它是唯一一个以“ma”作为最后一个假名的）。结果表中有一个神秘的名字，Barunda(A)。

segments.original: Adding both of the above sets together, not counting the mysterious name and the orb Pokémon, gets us the total number of 30 Pokémon. There were a total of 31 Pokémon voted for in the popularity contest, so we’re left with a name and a design that don’t fit anywhere else – therefore it’s safe to assume that the round Pokémon was in fact named Barunda. To strengthen the argument that the orb and Barunda are the same monster, we point out the following: ⦁ Barunda seems to be a pun on balloons, and the orb Pokémon does look like one;
segments.translation: 将上述两组相加，不计神秘名字和球体宝可梦，我们得到总共30只宝可梦。人气竞赛中总共有31只宝可梦被投票，所以我们剩下一个名字和一个设计无处可放——因此可以安全地假设那个圆形的宝可梦实际上名叫Barunda。 为了加强球体和Barunda是同一只怪物的论点，我们指出以下内容： ⦁ Barunda似乎是气球的双关语，而球体宝可梦看起来确实像一个气球；

segments.original: The comment under the name “Barunda” on the voting table refers to it as “ふわふわ” fuwafuwa – an onomatopoeia for floating and referring specifically to balloons. The same onomatopoeia was a basis for Drifloon’s Japanese name, Fuwante.

segments.original: THE FIRST POPULARITY POLL (October 1992)
segments.translation: 第一次人气投票（1992年10月）

segments.original: “Looking at the November 1992 Game Freak internal bulletin, we can see that the first popularity vote was held in October that year.  The top 3 favourite Pokémon were chosen from the about 80 monsters created at the time. We’ll report the surprising result here. “Pocket monster” popularity vote result announcement! As a result of voting by all participants, the most popular monsters are the following: 1st place, Exeggutor 2nd place, Slowbro 3rd place, Clefairy following, Grimer, Exeggcute, Cubone, Nidoran (female), Ivysaur … … etc. Judging by the results, it seems that popularity has concentrated on cute monsters such as Clefairy, Cubone etc —-. By this time, although Pikachu and Meowth were not yet there, it can be said that it is a very surprising result, I do not know why Exeggutor won first place. (…) After that, the same popularity vote was repeated several times.”
segments.translation: “查看1992年11月的GAME FREAK内部刊物，我们可以看到第一次人气投票是在那年10月举行的。当时从大约80只被创作出来的怪兽中选出了前三名最受欢迎的宝可梦。 我们将在此报告令人惊讶的结果。“口袋妖怪”人气投票结果公布！ 根据所有参与者的投票结果，最受欢迎的怪兽如下： 第一名，椰蛋树 第二名，呆壳兽 第三名，皮皮 接下来是，臭泥，蛋蛋，卡拉卡拉，尼多兰（雌性），妙蛙草……等等。 从结果来看，人气似乎集中在皮皮、卡拉卡拉等可爱的怪兽上——。此时，虽然皮卡丘和喵喵还没有出现，但可以说这是一个非常令人惊讶的结果，我不知道为什么椰蛋树赢得了第一名。（……）之后，同样的人气投票又重复了几次。”
